breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions. The incomplete prompt listed both periodic and Dirichlet conditions. The ground truth removed the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The agent's generated specification also correctly removed the contradictory Dirichlet condition and only specifies 'periodic boundary conditions for both u and u_x', which is consistent with the domain and the ground truth.
